assets.name: zoutcentrale
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original painted 2.5D action RPG battlefield background, 1536 x 1024 pixels, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: "De Zoutcentrale", an abandoned coastal desalination plant and salt basins amid climate drought.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND CAMERA reference only: match its premium hand-painted environment craftsmanship, isometric elevated camera, warm detailed materials, and very large open central playable court. Create a NEW location.
Scene: turquoise reservoirs and white mineral salt crust surround a huge paved industrial court. Rusted brass pumps, desalination machinery, low pipes, salt basins and weathered coastal plant architecture are confined to the outermost edges. Drought-scarred modern salvaged climate infrastructure, no medieval castle.
Composition: fixed 3/4 elevated isometric game camera, same scale and perspective as the reference. An enormous UNBROKEN, FLAT, WALKABLE PAVED COURT occupies the entire middle, approximately x15%-88%, y18%-76% of the image. Every point in that central zone is clear flat pavement. Subtle tile seams and painted material variation only. Put all buildings, machinery, water, barriers, steps, debris and props along the outermost perimeter, outside this central zone. Clear open combat space dominates the picture.
Style: premium painterly Torchlight-like original RPG environment craftsmanship, sculpted forms, warm brown edges, rich material texture, no pixel art, no photorealism.
Palette and light: sun-bleached ivory salt, turquoise reservoirs, rusted copper and brass, warm drought sunlight, painterly atmospheric depth.
Constraints: 1536x1024 landscape; NO characters, creatures, vehicles in the court, NO portals, NO text, NO letters, NO labels, NO logos, NO UI. NO central obstacles, trees, wells, machinery, pools, dividers, staircases or raised platforms. Pavement fills the central zone with continuous traversable space.

assets.name: enemy-atlas
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent PNG enemy sprite atlas for original painted 2.5D action RPG, exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Input images are STYLE references ONLY: match the premium painterly material depth, warm brown outlines, steel, teal and brass salvage detailing. Create NEW enemy designs and clean transparency, do not reproduce reference atlas subjects or its layout.
Layout: EXACTLY 3 EQUAL COLUMNS by 2 EQUAL ROWS. SIX isolated full-body monster sprites total. Each cell is 512x512 px. Centres are (256,256), (768,256), (1280,256), (256,768), (768,768), (1280,768). Every monster fully contained within its own cell with generous transparent margin on every side, no overlaps. An invisible grid, no grid lines.
Column 1: "Magneetkrab", a rust crab-like magnet mine-layer robot; low broad crab silhouette with articulated steel legs, rust/brass plated dome, teal magnetic coils and compact mine dispensing apparatus. Row 1 readied neutral pose. Row 2 attacking windup pose, legs braced and magnet/mine mechanism extended, same design.
Column 2: "Resonant", a slim hooded translucent cyan hologram surveyor drone; slender hovering humanoid-shaped projection with angular hood, a compact brass/teal survey core and fine measuring apparatus, cyan translucent body, distinct narrow silhouette. Row 1 readied neutral pose. Row 2 attacking windup pose, arm raised with focused scanning energy inside the cell, same design.
Column 3: "Pekelbreker", a heavy ivory desalination exosuit with TWO hose arms; bulky bipedal salvaged industrial armor, thick ivory mineral encrusted plates, brass joints, teal pressure tanks, two flexible armored hose arms with nozzle fists. Row 1 readied neutral pose. Row 2 attacking windup pose with both hose arms cocked for a strike, same design.
Camera: all six in the same 3/4 isometric perspective, facing down/right, fixed scale within species, full body visible, feet and all extremities inside the cells.
Style: premium original painted steel/teal/brass modern climate-apocalypse RPG monsters; rich material lighting and consistent warm brown outline, Torchlight-like painterly craftsmanship, no pixel art.
Transparency: genuinely transparent background and all inter-cell space. NO cast shadows, NO floor contact shadows, NO ground planes, NO background, NO text, NO labels, NO letters, NO frames, NO grid marks. Exactly six full bodies, exactly two rows and three columns.
